Reviewed against local main 7057a8d5a2d898c1bfb528a28f3f635dda639b8b, origin/main 568ce108 (local main clean, 112 ahead/0 behind at audit; no push).

Where we are: ResultArtifacts still calls runwise.runs.map(_.resolvedVoxelStatuses(position)) inside per-voxel lookup (current lines 179 and 191). C4's point lookup fix elsewhere and the current passing fit suite did not repair this export path. C3 voxelwise-RRG port remains separately deferred.

Fresh context: Yes: current export allocation defect.

Next action: Replace repeated full-vector expansion with direct bounded status lookup/aggregation, add a whole-export allocation regression and JVM/JS checks; handle C3 on its qualified re-port rather than the mixed-era snapshot.

Evidence: modules/fit/.../ResultArtifacts.scala; docs/verification/consolidation-20261005.md.

This is a tracker/source/retained-evidence assessment, not a new experiment or test run. Existing acceptance criteria and owner decisions remain binding; dated source-state statements below are superseded where this assessment explicitly corrects them.
